# Daily Briefing – Friday 2 January 2026

Yesterday was a mixed bag. No training session logged and only 7,758 steps, but your body still burned 2,382 kcal — slightly above your 2,300 target, which is a small win for the deficit. The real concern is sleep: 4.3 hours simply isn't enough recovery, and that needs addressing today.

The good news is your HRV sits at 108ms, right in your 99–119ms baseline, and your resting HR is an impressive 45 bpm. Your body is coping well despite the poor sleep. If a session is planned today, go ahead — but keep intensity moderate rather than pushing hard, given the sleep debt.

Tonight, prioritise getting to bed earlier — aim for 7–8 hours. Poor sleep directly undermines fat loss toward your 80–85kg target, no matter how clean your nutrition is. Hit your 175g protein today and you're back on track. 💪
